name: Horde Intervention: a Horde Supplies crate credits once however fast it is clicked (#10551)
contract: Quest 175150 needs 7 of 16 Horde Supplies crates (gameobject 2300709) destroyed. One use destroys a crate: one crate is one credit.

The crate's SmartAI despawns it one second after use and the goober has no auto-close, so every further click during that second credited the quest again and the same crate could be destroyed several times, as reported.
Expected: three clicks on the same crate in a row credit 1, not 3, and the crate disappears; after its 60 s respawn the same crate is usable again and credits the next use.
